incident-bot: ALERT: streaming-decode p99 spike detected in prod us-west-2. p95 ~650ms, p99 ~1800ms, SLO breach. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (streaming) and /v1/chat/stream.
Maria C: I'm on it — pulling traces and kernel footprints now. Oncall for infra is @Samir P.
Samir P: here, looking at infra metrics. Pager shows memory paging increase + syscall stalls on GPU nodes. Can you dump the kernel build id from one of the hot hosts?
Maria C: pasted trace snippet: ```trace_id: 000a1f3c\nkernel_build: rtx-trt8-2026-03-14\nmodule: decode.runtime\nflags: --use-flashattn=true --jit-compile=on\nstack: decode->kv_cache->flashattn_kernel```
Lia N: saw same spikes on canary earlier this morning around the new TRT/FlashAttn kernel rollout. Deploy bot reported partial rollout at 03:20 UTC.
deploy-bot: canary rollout: kernel rtx-trt8-2026-03-14 -> 40% (nodes: 12/30)
Samir P: that matches. Paging + tail stalls after kernel switch. Hypothesis: new compile path + flags cause suboptimal memory access pattern for streaming workload.
Jeff L: capturing perf counters on a reproducer VM now. If it's kernel-level, we may need rollback. Any quick mitigations?
Maria C: mitigation options: 1) rollback kernel to rtx-trt8-2026-03-10, 2) force-model-fallback to legacy decode kernel variant, 3) increase KV cache TTL to reduce kernel hot path churn. Recommend rollback canary -> rollback cluster.
triage-bot: Customer impact: ~1.8% of active sessions saw stalls >5s. Top customers impacted: "search-ai" (US-WEST), "chatflow" (EU-west route routed via US-west).
Samir P: initiating rollback of kernel canary. Command: ```infractl kernel rollback --cluster prod-west --from rtx-trt8-2026-03-14 --to rtx-trt8-2026-03-10 --scope canary```
deploy-bot: Rollback started: canary rollback to rtx-trt8-2026-03-10. Estimated completion 6m.
Maria C: I'm toggling routing policy to prefer dedicated nodes without the new kernel for streaming routes (temporary). Routing change: /v1/chat/stream -> dedicated-pool-legacy :thumbsup:
Samir P: monitoring p95/p99 now. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/inference/slo/p99?env=prod-west&range=15m
Maria C: after routing change p95 dropped to 420ms, p99 -> 950ms (improvement but still above SLO).
Jeff L: perf counters show 3x more page faults in flashattn kernel variant on streaming sequences >1024 tokens. Root cause looking like kernel memory layout + compile option --jit-compile aggressive inlining.
Samir P: pushing hotfix: disable JIT aggressive in compile flags for next build and pause flashattn flag for streaming path. Patch: ``--jit-compile=off --use-flashattn=false`` to test.
triage-bot: Update: rollback canary completed, global rollback scheduled if telemetry stabilizes in 10m.
Maria C: opening postmortem ticket and adding failing prompt set to evals so we detect this earlier. Link: https://issues.redwood/internal/PM-4821
Samir P: customer comms: Ops to draft note to affected customers with ETA and mitigation steps. Lia can you coordinate?
Lia N: will draft. Suggest: mention rollback, mitigation (routing and kernel rollback), apology, and offer deeper follow-up for impacted customers.
Ops Pager: handoff to night oncall in 30m. Current state: rollback done on canary, routing mitigation applied, global rollback pending if p99 > 800ms in next 10m.
Samir P: Handoff: @Jeff L will take ownership of root cause reproducer and kernel patch. @Maria C continue monitoring SLOs and customer impact. Night oncall please watch streaming p95/p99 and paging counters on prod-west.
Maria C: quick reproduction steps added to ticket: ```python reproduce.py --seq-len 2048 --model gpt-xl --stream true --workers 16``` — reproduces tail stall locally against new kernel image.
Jeff L: got it, I'll start a local kernel build with disabled aggressive compile flags and run microbenchmarks.
Samir P: leaving note in incident log and setting severity to Sev2 -> watching. If global rollback needed I'll trigger in prod. Otherwise handoff complete. :pray:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 trending down to ~480ms after canary rollback and routing changes. Monitoring for 30m before closing.
Lia N: thanks team, handoff note pushed to #incidents. I'll ping customers once we confirm stabilization.
Samir P: end-handoff — ping me if anything flares.
